subject: Critical path fallback play / exec summit prep
messages:
From: Tom Garvey <tom.garvey@aureliasys.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Critical path fallback play / exec summit prep

Karthik / Laura / Ben,

Quick note from procurement: we have an internal supplier hold that will push our PO by at least 10 business days unless we surface the exec-level trade-offs this week. That would push our planned acceptance window past the planned go-live and affect the launch cohort.

Can you share a short MAP update and a fallback that shrinks the acceptance scope so we can still meet the external launch target?

We'd like to escalate to our execs on Monday; if you can provide the options and the impact on SLA/costs that will help.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Garvey
Head of Platform Integrations
Aurelia Systems

Attachment: none (requesting MAP + SOW update)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Garvey <tom.garvey@aureliasys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Critical path fallback play / exec summit prep

Tom — thanks for the heads up.

Quick summary from our side and an immediate fallback proposal:

1) Root blocker: Aurelia procurement certification sign-off is gating purchase order issuance (internal hold).
2) Fast fallback (Scope-shrink): Accept an initial pilot lane limited to 5 internal teams (reduced throughput, limited integrations) that requires only minimal SOW items; this keeps an external pilot date within the original window but defers full multi-tenant rollout.
3) Timeline impact: pilot keeps go-live target of Jan 8 (no change). Full rollout shifts ~3 weeks after PO clearance.
4) Cost/SLA implication: pilot will run on Dedicated preview capacity with a temporary usage uplift (~+12% unit cost) to ensure latency SLOs during reduced isolation.

Action items we are sending:
- Updated MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) with the pilot lane and acceptance criteria (attached).
- Redlined SOW (SOW_Redline_Aurelia.pdf) narrowing deliverables for pilot.
- Acceptance checklist for pilot (Acceptance_Checklist.xlsx).

If you want exec-level language, we can produce a 1-page trade-off memo for your leadership by EOD Monday. Are you available for a 30-min prep sync Monday morning?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW_Redline_Aurelia.pdf, Acceptance_Checklist.xlsx

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Garvey <tom.garvey@aureliasys.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Critical path fallback play / exec summit prep

Adding procurement perspective from our side — high level notes: 

- Internal checklist: security questionnaire (SOC2 artifacts) completes on Dec 9, legal review sign-off expected Dec 11. PO issuance earliest realistic date: Dec 15 given your vendor hold.
- Given those dates, the full SOW cannot be executed until signatures are in place. Pilot lane is the right mitigation to preserve the external launch.

Proposed re-baseline for acceptance gates (if pilot accepted):
- Pilot acceptance window: Jan 6–12 (keep the external target intact).
- Full acceptance gate: shifted to Feb 5–12 (dependent on PO date).

Small ask to Aurelia: can procurement commit to an internal exec confirm call by Dec 5? That short checkpoint would reduce uncertainty and allow us to finalize the pilot SOW.

Ben, please confirm if we should open a formal escalation note to Sales Leadership for partial credit / concession options if the PO slips beyond Dec 20 — I want alignment before we present to Aurelia execs.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Garvey <tom.garvey@aureliasys.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Critical path fallback play / exec summit prep

Thanks all — consolidating into the exec summit brief. Quick escalation log entry and ask below for your records.

Escalation summary (to present Monday):
- Trigger: Aurelia procurement supplier hold -> PO delay risk (impacting full rollout).
- Immediate mitigation: scoped pilot lane (5 teams) that preserves external pilot go-live and reduces integration surface area.
- Residual risk: full rollout slippage (~3–4 weeks) if PO not issued by Dec 15.
- Business impact: potential revenue deferral for Q1 and minor cost uplift during pilot (~+12%).

Requested approvals (internal):
- Ben: confirm discretionary concession framework (partial credit cap or deferred billing window) we can offer if PO > Dec 20.
- Laura: confirm CS resources available for compressed acceptance (two parallel validation streams).
- Aurelia: confirm exec checkpoint Dec 5 or alternative date this week.

Meeting ask: propose 30-min exec summit Monday 12:30–13:00 PT to align on the memo and decision points. I'll circulate the 1-page trade-off memo and MAP extracts beforehand.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 02 Dec 2025 at 08:34, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Given those dates, the full SOW cannot be executed until signatures are in place. Pilot lane is the right mitigation to preserve the external launch.

Tom — please confirm Dec 5 exec checkpoint or suggest an alternate time. We want to go to your leadership with a single recommended fallback and the associated impacts.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW_Redline_Aurelia.pdf, Acceptance_Checklist.xlsx
